metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Brightwell Mutual (insurance); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.80.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster bright-prod-euwest (EKS); Istio service mesh (mTLS STRICT); workload certificates are signed by istiod with an intermediate CA certificate that cert-manager obtains from a Vault PKI issuer; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: During what hour did the service outage begin? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
